title: Insert Table Column (Tables)

scenarios.title: Insert Table Column applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Table Column (BtnTableColumnInsertion) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableColumnInsertion deterministic Office leg (insert right, preserve width)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'insert right, preserve width' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected) inserts one empty column at index 3 and scales all four columns so the total width stays the 300 pt original (75 pt per column), keeps the 150 pt height, the 40/40 position, the three 50 pt rows and the original texts shifted right of the new empty column, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'insert right, preserve width' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected) inserts one empty column at index 3 and scales all four columns so the total width stays the 300 pt original (75 pt per column), keeps the 150 pt height, the 40/40 position, the three 50 pt rows and the original texts shifted right of the new empty column, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.title: BtnTableColumnInsertion deterministic Office leg (duplicate column format)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'duplicate format left' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected, source column 2 pre-formatted blue with 15 pt font) inserts an empty column at index 3 carrying the source column's 100 pt width and a full copy of its blue fill and 15 pt font (the explicit fill and font copy in CopyCellFormat), leaves the original formatted column at index 2 with its format intact, keeps the 50 pt rows and the 40/40 position, redistributes the original columns to 75 pt while the new column takes the source column's 100 pt (table 325x150, the real-host measured PowerPoint behavior), reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'duplicate format left' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected, source column 2 pre-formatted blue with 15 pt font) inserts an empty column at index 3 carrying the source column's 100 pt width and a full copy of its blue fill and 15 pt font (PickUp/Apply plus the explicit font copy), leaves the original formatted column at index 2 with its format intact, keeps the 50 pt rows and the 40/40 position, redistributes the original columns to 75 pt while the new column takes the source column's 100 pt (table 325x150, the real-host measured PowerPoint behavior), reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
